An Association Number to use in the MACsec's reception secure association LowestPn Lowest accepted Packet Number in the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (in) Active Boolean to enable/disable the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Request the Ethernet Switch Driver to update the Reception Secure Association with the given Packet Number. The Active parameter is included to change the specified AN status. Tags: atp.Status=DRAFT Available via EthIf.h
